goal.objective: Independently review the preregistered E1-E H2 apparatus integration against the frozen registration. Diagnose mismatches, leakage, lifecycle/governance violations, or implementation defects. This is a read-only review: do not modify repository files and do not execute the scientific experiment.
goal.pass_definition: Review the supplied apparatus, registry, lifecycle integration, frozen registration fixture, E1-D predecessor harness, and tests. Report concrete concerns in the terminal structured diagnosis. Make no repository changes. The coordinator must independently run and pass all 49 authoritative regression tests.

validation.command:
import subprocess,sys
patterns=[('test_e1_e_h2_early_explore_predictor.py', 15), ('test_e1_e_lifecycle_compatibility.py', 4), ('test_e1_d_h1b_resource_density.py', 5), ('test_e1_lifecycle.py', 21), ('test_e1_orchestrator.py', 4)]
for pattern, expected in patterns:
    cp=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p',pattern,'-v'], text=True, capture_output=True)
    sys.stdout.write(cp.stdout)
    sys.stderr.write(cp.stderr)
    combined=(cp.stdout or '')+(cp.stderr or '')
    if cp.returncode != 0 or f'Ran {expected} test' not in combined or '\nOK' not in combined.replace('\r\n','\n'):
        raise SystemExit(cp.returncode or 97)
print('QWEN_AUTHORITATIVE_VALIDATION: 49/49 PASS')
validation.timeout_reason: Authoritative validation runs E1-E, E1-D, lifecycle process-tree, and orchestrator regressions on Windows.
